from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted metadata for a single legal document relevant to cause of action filtering."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or filename of the legal document, used for the final answer list")
    stated_case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
